## Summary

Explain the change and the narrow problem it addresses.

## Provenance

- Original author and subject:
- Canonical source URL or message ID:
- Local modifications/backports:
- Authorship and sign-off metadata preserved:
- Licensing notes:

Use `TODO: provenance needs manual verification` wherever evidence is missing.

## Validation

- [ ] `bash -n scripts/*.sh`
- [ ] `shellcheck scripts/*.sh` (if available)
- [ ] Every spec source and patch exists
- [ ] `rpmbuild -bp` succeeds
- [ ] Full RPM build succeeds, or the reason it was not run is documented
- [ ] No RPMs were installed during validation
- [ ] No private machine information was added
